notes.title: Train Yard Builder Update #4 - Bugfixes!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Engineers! [/p][p]We’ve just rolled out a new update for [i]Train Yard Builder[/i]! While this patch doesn’t bring major new content, it includes a range of important improvements that make the game smoother, more stable, and more enjoyable to play.[/p][h3] What’s New & Improved:[/h3][list][*][p][b]General performance optimizations[/b]
Better FPS and smoother gameplay across a wider range of hardware.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug fixes[/b]
We’ve squashed several bugs, including some  crashes and visual glitches.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better train behavior[/b] 
Tweaks to improve how your trains navigate the tracks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Under-the-hood stability improvements[/b]
Making sure everything runs better behind the scenes.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for continuing to support [i]Train Yard Builder[/i]! We’re working hard on more features, polish, and improvements. Your feedback helps shape the future of the game – keep it coming![/p][p]All aboard!

notes.title: Train Yard Builder Update #3 - Hotfixes!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, Gamers![/h2]

We’re so delighted that you’re enjoying Train Yard Builder so much! We have another batch of fresh hotfixes for you. This time we focused more on improving the stability of the game as well as making the game more accessible for all!

Check out the detailed list of changes [b]below:[/b]

[list]
[*] Detail drawing range settings have been added
[*] Additional information has been added for tasks involving cleaning, painting, dioramas, and museum task
[*] More diorama presets with museum task models with bug-proofing changes
[*] Fixed ghosts of the basketball court and railroad crossing
[*] German characters have been added to the key hints
[*] Camera jumping has been disabled while working on dioramas
[*] The hint during object painting has been moved above the variant list, as it pertains to the variants
[*] Text-containing hints have been enlarged
[*] Some fonts have been enlarged
[*] Detail drawing range settings have been added
[*] Additional information has been added for tasks involving cleaning, painting, dioramas, and museum task
[*] The levitating EP101 train after loading the game has been fixed
[*] Implemented generating diorama tasks with museum models
[*] Fixed problem with loading placed models on the dioramas
[/list]

Once again we wanted to thank you for your continued support for the game! Be on the watch for more changes in the future. Remember, we are always open to discussing your needs, problems or suggestions.

[url=https://discord.gg/frozenwayofficial][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40812718/fde3de6b7aeef410b01270c8576653b6bf2d87e8.png[/img][/url]

Happy Gaming!
Jacob and the Developers Team

notes.title: Train Yard Builder Update #2 - Photo Mode is ON!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, Gamers![/h2]

Thank you for the support we've received since the launch. Hearing how much you're enjoying the game fills us with pride and satisfaction. We worked hard to bring a new batch of improvements for you over the past week and while doing so we’ve added a few new things to the collection.

The biggest and most of the requested features was a [b]Photo Mode[/b] so with a few bits and pieces we managed to add it to the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40812718/9a81fbda707c323e9e6b6ac3bfecf3bc8bfe8f7b.gif[/img]

With addition we added some other stuff:
[list]
[*]  A keyboard shortcut has been added to the camera system responsible for switching to the next train
[*] An option to disable the grid while placing objects has been added
[*] Added 9 new track variants
[*] Added settings to adjust the camera movement speed in building mode
[*] Diorama tasks based on a new presets with backward compatibility
[*] Added a new diorama presets
[*] Updated available diorama preset list (restricted to default items)
[*] New mails that informs about new exhibitions or completed exhibitions
[/list]

[h3]Along with the new addition you can read the [b]full batch of fixes down below:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed problem with missing restrictions in diorama task
[*] Redundant items in the inventory have been fixed.
[*] Tags are now correctly highlighted when the search matches a visible tag.
[*] After hiding the UI in the camera system, the change of the train was blocked when the UI reappeared.
[*] Displaying a message about the inability to place the table
[*] Hide a storyline button if there is no previous save to load
[*] Disabled game mode hint in the pause menu in sandbox mode
[*] Fixed removing placeables from sub-grids & removing museum items on task completed
[*] Fixed displaying task items on the first enter to the cleaning machine
[*] The 'User Made' tag has been removed from the tags in the Storyline game
[*] The 'Used' tag has been removed from the tags in the Sandbox game
[*] Fixed the issue where used items were not being found using the Search Field
[*] Fixed snapping dioramas to grid
[*] Fixed problem that dioramas didn't fit into diorama tool placing area
[*] Fixed occuring foliage items in sandbox inventory when we filter them by searcher (ex. trees)
[*]Optimized terrain resetting under placed model
[*] Fixed cloning dioramas after placing in sandbox
[*] Fixed some textures not saving on objects that can be painted
[*] Fixed loading items in sandbox mode and removed missing item data
[*] Fixed creating ghosts of mountain slopes & added missing null checks
[*] Fixed placement of decorations on diorama presets 
[*] Fixed problem with displaying museum task rewards
[*] Fixed unlocking "The Great Exhibition" achievement
[/list]


Remember, we are always open to discussing your needs, problems or suggestions. Once again, thank you for the support you have given us! 

[url=https://discord.gg/frozenwayofficial][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40812718/fde3de6b7aeef410b01270c8576653b6bf2d87e8.png[/img][/url]

Happy Gaming!
Jacob and the Developers Team

notes.title: Train Yard Builder 1st Hotfix!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, Gamers![/h2]

We see you enjoying the game for the past few days. But we’ve also heard the voices of those who can’t enjoy the game as much. Developers have been working hard to fix the issues some of you reported since the premiere. Here’s the detailed patchlist!

[list]
[*] Added an instruction button to the mods panel.
[*] Fixed issues with cancelling exhibitions in specific cases.
[*] Updated the URL address to the Steam Workshop.
[*] Fixed the display of correct binding icons.
[*] Fixed the issue where models would disappear when dragged off the table.
[*] Fixed a null reference exception when dragging groups of models.
[*] Fixed saving rebind changes.
[*] Fixed issues with the game not working on Steam Deck.
[*] Fixed saving and loading model colour variants in diorama schemas, table schemas, and related mods.
[*] Fixed camera resetting to the current table's bounds in sandbox mode.
[*] Disabled the highlighting of modded items after loading the game.
[*] Fixed the issue where rebinding WSAD keys in build mode was not possible.
[*] Fixed the management of available diorama task items.
[*] Added an additional check to ignore museum items in diorama tasks.
[*] Fixed the display of single selected model hints when multiple models are already selected.
[*] Fixed the correct popup display when only one model is selected using the multi-select tool.
[*] Fixed loading the Circus on a table.
[*] Set up missing item tags (Circus, Ferris Wheel, Steel Bridge Ramp, Wooden Cart 1 and 2).
[*] Fixed incorrect key hint icons on the Steam Deck.
[*] Removed mods locally after unsubscribing from the Steam Workshop.
[*] Fixed downloading all subscribed mods on each game start, even when they are already downloaded in the Steamapps Workshop files.
[*] Fixed the display of mod titles and descriptions from the Steam Workshop.
[*] Fixed invalid textures on trains/carriages in boxes.
[*] Fixed the generation of painting task parameters.
[*] Fixed the simultaneous display of multiple tasks.
[*] Fixed a blocker in the painting task.
[*] Updated the list of tags in the mod project.
[*] Fixed the position of the lights on the Class 8 train.
[*] Fixed word search in tags.
[*] Fixed the ability to place models while in camera tool mode.
[*] Fixed the ability to display the inventory UI in table management.
[*] Fixed the collider that was blocking interaction with model boxes (storyline).
[*] Managed the disabling of ceiling lamps when entering building mode (sandbox).
[*] Fixed camera clipping in building mode (sandbox).
[*] Added zoom sensitivity option
[*] Added trains and carriages boxes inspection functionality
[*] The tag-based removal tool function has been fixed.
[*] Fixed the collision with Grandpa's table in the museum to prevent falling under the map.
[/list]

We’ve also wanted to thank you for such a warm welcome for Train Yard Builder! The reviews have been heartwarming. Remember that the game will be on the Release Discount until the 23rd of September.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1674900/Train_Yard_Builder/

Thank you so much for your continued support! We hope you’ll enjoy the game and will fulfil your creativity!
As always, we invite you to follow us on our social media channels to stay up to date with the latest news. Our official Discord server is open to everyone.

[url=https://discord.gg/frozenwayofficial][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40812718/fde3de6b7aeef410b01270c8576653b6bf2d87e8.png[/img][/url]

Happy Creating!
~Jacob and the Developer Team

notes.title: New Trailer & Release date!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, Gamers![/h1]

This was a wild ride, but we’re finally ready to show you the [b]new trailer[/b] for Train Yard Builder! But wait! That’s not all! Along with the trailer we’re rolling out [b]the release date[/b]!
Check more information down below!

[h1]Who’s ready for more trains?[/h1]

[previewyoutube=E_MezrDdEF4;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Choo choo![/i]

As you can see the whole game got a bit of a graphical glow-up compared to the previous trailer. Get ready to create the Dioramas of your dreams. Paint the models and prepare some scenes for fellow hobbyists! 


[h1]Release Date![/h1]

Get your train driver hat ready! The game launches on [b]September the 16th[/b]! I hope by that time you’ll be ready to create your favourite diorama. If you want to know more visit our freshly updated Steam Page!


[b]Jacob and The Development Team[/b]
